CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.kc_search_vector_update()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    NEW.search_vector :=
        setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(NEW.heading, '')), 'B') ||
        setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(NEW.content_text, '')), 'C');
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
